title: Committing new file versions against a storage quota
name: File version commit

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code keeps file metadata and storage usage consistent with each other? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Two devices call commitNewVersion for the same file at the same moment. How are their version numbers assigned?
choices: Both may get the same version number because max(version) is read concurrently
The second blocks on the FOR UPDATE row lock until the first commits, then gets the next number
The second fails immediately with a lock error
Version numbers are random, so collisions are irrelevant

questions.prompt: A user is at their quota and uploads a smaller replacement for an existing file. What does adjustUsage do?
choices: Rejects it with QuotaExceededError because usage is already at the limit
Applies the negative delta, since used_bytes + delta is still within quota
Skips the update because delta is negative
Sets used_bytes to the new file size

questions.prompt: In trash(), the journal INSERT fails. What is the resulting state?
choices: The file is marked deleted but the usage is not reduced
Usage is reduced but the file is still visible
Neither the deletion nor the usage change is kept
The file is deleted and usage reduced, only the journal entry is missing
